# Evenementtypen a -klassen

De Viewer setzt eng Kolonn **Evenementtyp** bei all Datesaz mat enger Evenementkolonn (`event`, `events`, `event_type` oder `event_name`). All Spill hir eege Wierder ginn engem vun dësen Typen zougeuerdnet (grouss a kleng Buschtawen ginn d'selwecht); e Wuert, dat net gelëscht ass, zielt als *Soss*.

| Typ | Gewisen als | Wierder an den Donnéeën |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | Positioun | `(eidel)`, `position`, `pos`, `sample`, `move`, `vehicle` |
| `fire` | Schoss | `burst`, `shot`, `gun_shot`, `fire`, `fire_start`, `fire_stop`, `weapon_fire`, `slash`, `hasfired`, `shoot`, `fired`, `tracer` |
| `launch` | Start (Rakéit, Bomm) | `launch`, `launched`, `torpedo`, `throw`, `release` |
| `hit` | Treffer | `hit`, `hit_critical`, `hit_severe`, `struck`, `impact`, `hasbeenhitby` |
| `miss` | Feelschoss | `miss`, `missed` |
| `explosion` | Explosioun | `explosion`, `flak`, `he`, `molotov`, `inferno`, `smoke`, `flash`, `explode` |
| `damage` | Schued | `hurt`, `damage`, `damaged`, `module_destroyed`, `wounded`, `fire_on`, `blind` |
| `kill` | Ofschoss | `kill`, `kills` |
| `death` | Doud | `death`, `dead`, `died`, `killed` |
| `destroyed` | Zerstéiert | `destroyed` |
| `crash` | Ofstuerz | `crash`, `crashed` |
| `eject` | Ausstig | `eject`, `ejected`, `bailout`, `bailedout` |
| `spawn` | Spawn | `spawn`, `respawn`, `revived`, `created` |
| `despawn` | Despawn | `despawn`, `removed`, `leftarea`, `timeout` |
| `takeoff` | Offlug | `takenoff`, `takeoff` |
| `landing` | Landung | `landed`, `landing` |
| `touchdown` | Buedemkontakt | `touchdown`, `touch_and_go` |
| `stop` | Halt | `stop`, `parked` |
| `rearm` | Neibewaffnung / Tanken | `rearm`, `rearmed`, `refuel`, `refuelled`, `refueled`, `repair`, `repaired` |
| `capture` | Eroberung / Zil | `captured`, `capture`, `neutralised`, `neutralized`, `plant`, `defuse` |
| `decoy` | Täuschkierper | `flare`, `chaff`, `decoy`, `countermeasure` |
| `message` | Message | `chat`, `message`, `command`, `bookmark`, `debug`, `comment` |
| `other` | Soss | `grenade`, `projectile`, `nade`, `thrown`, `flight` |

## Gefierklassen {#vehicle-classes}

D'Kolonnen **Gefierklass** an **Zilklass** benotzen dës Klassen, ausgerechent aus de Gefierennimm (iwwer de [Figurekatalog](figures.md)) an den Typkolonnen.

| Klass | Gewisen als |
|---|---|
| `fighter` | Jeeër |
| `attack` | Attackfliger |
| `bomber` | Bomber |
| `otherAir` | Aere Fliger |
| `helicopter` | Helikopter |
| `tank` | Panzer |
| `armoured` | Gepanzert Gefier |
| `spaa` | Loftofwier |
| `artillery` | Artillerie |
| `truck` | Camion / Auto |
| `ship` | Schëff |
| `submarine` | U-Boot |
| `infantry` | Infanterie |
| `weapon` | Waff |
| `decoy` | Täuschkierper |
| `structure` | Gebai |
